verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents self-serve, pay-per-token billing with no minimums, contracts, or hidden fees, and refers to each model's 'standard per-token price', which implies per-model token pricing without a sales conversation. However, no evidence shows a public price list or pricing page covering every hosted model. Missing for 10: evidence of a public per-model pricing page with actual per-token rates, confirmation that every hosted model has listed prices, independent corroboration.
